{"id":1969207512,"question_id":4149,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1775360822,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"16 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1969207512/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Increase to Maximize Special Indices","memory":"159.6 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    long long minIncrease(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n\n        vector<ll>oprs(n , 0);\n        for(int i = 1 ; i<n-1 ; i++){\n            ll maxi = max(nums[i-1] , nums[i+1]);\n            oprs[i] = max(0LL , (maxi + 1 - nums[i]));\n        }\n\n        int size = n-2;\n        if(size & 1)\n        {\n            ll ans = 0;\n            for(int i = 1 ; i<n-1 ; i+=2){\n                ans += oprs[i];\n            }\n            return ans;\n        }\n        else\n        {\n            int k = (size/2);\n            vector<ll>firsthalf(k+1 , 0);\n            vector<ll>secondhalf(k+1 , 0);\n    \n            for(int i = 1 ; i<=k ; i++){\n                firsthalf[i] = firsthalf[i-1] + oprs[2 * i - 1];\n            }\n\n            for(int i = 1 ; i<=k ; i++){\n                secondhalf[i] = secondhalf[i-1] + oprs[n - 2 * i];\n            }\n\n            ll min_oprs = firsthalf[0] + secondhalf[k];\n            for(int i = 1 ; i<=k ; i++){\n                min_oprs = min(min_oprs , (firsthalf[i] + secondhalf[k - i]));\n            }\n            return min_oprs;\n        } \n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-increase-to-maximize-special-indices","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1903}
